title: Grateful Dead Live at Great Western LA Forum on 1989-12-10
lineage: M-DAT -> DAT/1 -> Tascam DA-30 -> HHb CDR 800 PRO via analog i/o; CDR>EAC>TLH(6)>FLAC
source: Nakamichi CM-300s w/CP-4's -> Sony TCD-D10; Location: 2nd row OTS

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience tape with a brief digital noise glitch, highlighted by a standout "I'm a Man" performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience capture that sounds remarkably clear for the format, aside from a short burst of harsh diginoise in the second set. Reviewers describe the show as fun and energetic, singling out "I'm a Man" as a must‑listen moment. Overall it ranks among the better late‑80s tapes despite the minor glitch.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers are generally enthusiastic; one gives 4 stars and praises the recording, the other gives 3 stars but enjoys the show. The strong positive comments about performance and mostly excellent audio push the rating into the good‑to‑great range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and well‑balanced for an audience tape, with only a brief horrible diginoise artifact in the second set.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fun, energetic show that flows nicely according to reviewers.
